doc.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Bebop, band changes and the road
title: Why drummers dress sharply
summary: Asked about drummers' sartorial style, Hamilton says he wanted clothes of his own after hand-me-downs, and recalls his clean and sharply dressed father.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Now is that something about drummers in particular, I mean because we can go back and look through from Papa Jo, Sonny Greer, you know, all the way up through you, Roy, you know, and then you’ve got Philly Joe. I mean the drummers have always set a standard as far as the sartorial presentation, but you were early on so what was your -- first of all to answer the question, do you think this is something common to drummers and do you feel that you maybe contributed to that?
Well, you know, I’ve been complimented. You know, I’ve been complimented, let’s put it like that. But I’ve always been my own man. You know, I’ve been into dress, the clothes.

Well when you come up wearing hand me downs, all of a sudden, you know, decide you want something for yourself, you know, and I don’t want nobody’s hand me downs, you know, that type of thing. And like I told you earlier, I started buying my clothes when I was 11 years old, you know. Went to all the thrift shops and things like that.
Were you modeling yourself after somebody? I mean did you -- was it the musicians, you know, all were always clean, or the movie stars?
Just stay clean, you know. Just stay clean and sharp, you know, because all the musicians that I knew at that time were sharp.
It wasn’t the pimps that, you know, were really dapper? Was that an inspiration at all?

Well the pimps were cool too, man. That was cool. You know, during that period, those days, that era, everybody dressed. My father dressed. He wore a shirt and tie and suit every day and he was just, you know, a waiter, right, but he went to work sharp, plus the fact my father was probably one of the cleanest men I ever knew. Every night man he’d wash his socks and underwear out, you know. He was dynamite. He was cool.
So it sounds like you had some good modeling right there in the house.
